result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on rationalising sums of three square roots of bilinear expressions (sqrt(xy)+sqrt(zt)+sqrt(r)=0), with linear substitutions, parameter elimination in alpha, beta, gamma, lambda, and tables of 0/1 triples (characteristics), apparently related to theta characteristics and bitangents of quartics.

Identity xi(c eta - b zeta)+eta(a zeta - c xi)+zeta(b xi - a eta)=0 used to parametrise r and s
Three-root relations among linear forms after substitution
Product of four quadric-type factors equals a square (contact condition)
Linear relations among forms with parameters alpha, beta, gamma
Relation between lambda and lambda_1, lambda_2, lambda_3
Quartic relation among squared characteristic theta-like quantities
